report.speaker: rootched_speaker
report.text: The seed is set; the current says so. Good. The grove remembers where it was cut from: a Key sits in the Datacore's heart, where the biogrowth learned to count.

choices.text: Yev has a question about the cuttings.

yev_asks.speaker: yev
yev_asks.text: Speaker. The cuttings from my grove. Whose Key are they growing?

oriel_answers.speaker: rootched_speaker
oriel_answers.text: Ours, child. Yours. The grove's. There is no difference; that is the faith.

choices.text: There is a difference. Say it.
The Speaker is right. It is all one grove.

done.speaker: rootched_speaker
done.text: The Datacore, Weaver. Go slowly; the grove did.

early.speaker: rootched_speaker
early.text: The seed first. Nothing grows from a report.

idle.speaker: rootched_speaker
idle.text: The current is with you. Go well.
